jobs.description: 총괄표제부 kind Gold (root ADR-0450; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-register-masters): gold.parcel_register_masters from the current rows of silver.building_register_master, when the Silver lane or the served parcel edition moved past the pins the current Gold recorded. It recomputes only the PNUs whose current 총괄표제부 rows differ between the pinned and the current Silver (both directions, so a site that moved PNU leaves its old parcel) and of parcels that entered or left the served edition, and merges them; a change of the code change table rebuilds whole (building_register_master_silver_to_gold.WHOLE_TABLE_INPUTS). Its own job because an own-producer kind is never a table of `kinds` (root ADR-0287 §9). by_pnu_parcel_register_masters_bake bakes its commit.
jobs.memory_measured: no memory peak logged 2026-10-18..11-08 (no cap, so no memory accounting); sized as the script foundation-gold-panel-rebuild.service runs (307M measured, 57 runs); Spark runs in its own capped container; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own full build measured in its cut-over's gold step (the operator's copy of this unit, gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-register-masters): 129 s on 2026-11-09 for 581,357 rows (gold-kind mode=full 93 s). A new Silver release can change every row, so the first run as its unit is taken as a full build again: about five times it, 600 s, inside the 8,100 s share of the 150-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: 총괄표제부 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0450, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-register-masters → publisher build-parcel-register-masters-versions): gold.parcel_register_masters_versions, computed by DuckDB inside the publisher (record_kind_stage::REGISTER_MASTERS) and appended as the keys whose digest changed (a removal marker for a key that left), each commit one version_seq. While the lane serves gold.parcel_register_masters it is that table's shadow: it reads the input pins and served edition its foundation-gold-build tag commit recorded, so the takeover verdict (gold-takeover-verdict.sh) compares the two engines over one set of inputs; its first build holds every key. Nothing to do when its inputs, the served parcel edition and its code are the base commit's. A change of the code change table, the served edition or the code rebuilds every PNU; otherwise only the PNUs whose current sites or served parcels changed (KindVersionsStage::changed_pnus). Nothing reads it until the lane's takeover PR names it as the lane's gold_table.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261119T152616Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-nearby (2026-11-19 15:26-15:51Z, every served parcel, 39,861,511 rows committed in 1500 s), systemd's memory peak 7.2G, swap peak 13.5M; the publisher's own peak in its run log 7,733,563,392 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (parcel_nearby_versions_build MEMORY_SHARE) and DuckDB fills it and the page cache, so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak. The run fit: no timeout, 13.5M swap, under MemoryMax

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the first shadow build holds every key, so it reads the served parcel edition's PNUs (about 40 million, the read parcel-nearby's full build also makes, p90 1,502 s with its spatial work) and 621,193 sites (2026-11-09) and folds them in one statement; without the spatial work about 900 s, inside the 60-minute limit. Later runs rebuild the changed PNUs only.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_register_masters (the own-producer 총괄표제부 kind, root ADR-0450) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-register-masters), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9), exactly as the ownership bake. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2). Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_register_masters_rebuild commits a new snapshot, and at 11:05 as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the ownership bake's bound (root ADR-0138).

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own bakes measured in its cut-over's bake step (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh parcel-register-masters bake, the same by-pnu-serving-bake.sh): 277 s on 2026-11-09 for 581,357 documents; the first scheduled bake after the publish may cut a whole generation (no reads.jsonl yet, root ADR-0468 §4), so 900 s, inside the 6,210 s share of the 115-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

assets.title: 필지 총괄표제부 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지의 건축물대장 총괄표제부(대지·건축·연면적, 주용도, 주·부속 건축물 수, 총주차수, 허가·착공·사용승인일)를 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0450). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-register-masters)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, silver.building_register_master 의 현재 행에서 만든다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다.

assets.title: 필지 총괄표제부 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지의 건축물대장 총괄표제부를 담는 표(루트 ADR-0450)를 판을 쌓는 표로(루트 ADR-0564 §1·§2): gold.parcel_register_masters 의 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더해 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙인다. 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 계산하고 발행기가 추가 커밋으로 붙인다. 레인이 옛 표를 굽는 동안은 그 표의 그림자다(옛 표 빌드 태그의 입력 핀으로 짓는다, 루트 ADR-0564 §6).

assets.title: 필지 총괄표제부 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_register_masters 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/register-masters/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0450). 첫 발행은 자동 승격(루트 ADR-0435)이 한다.

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287 9항, ADR-0450): 관리건축물대장PK 마다의 현재 행을 서빙 필지판의 PNU에만 문서로 묶는다. 고정한 Silver 와 지금 Silver 에서 현재 행이 다른 PNU(양방향)와 필지판에 들고 난 PNU만 다시 계산한다.
개편으로 바뀐 코드에 걸린 총괄표제부 행을 서빙 필지판의 코드로 읽는다(모든 필지 섹션과 같은 renumbered, 루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 종류를 통째로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0450).
현재 총괄표제부 행(관리건축물대장PK 마다)을 서빙 법정동 코드로 다시 매겨 서빙 필지판의 PNU 에 접는다(DuckDB, 루트 ADR-0450). 행이 바뀐 PNU 만, 양쪽 모두(옮긴 대지는 옛 PNU 를 떠난다) 다시 짓는다.
서빙 필지판의 PNU 가 문서의 전체 집합이다(루트 ADR-0292). 들고 난 필지만 다시 짓는다.
재편으로 바뀐 코드의 행을 서빙 코드로 읽는다(루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 모든 PNU 를 다시 짓는다.
그림자인 동안 옛 표의 foundation-gold-build 태그 커밋이 적은 입력 핀과 서빙 에디션으로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0564 §6): 옛 표의 데이터가 아니라 그 빌드의 핀을 읽는다.
레인의 넘겨받기 PR 이 종류 줄의 gold_table 을 이 표로 바꾸면(판정 equal 뒤, 루트 ADR-0564 §6) 레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다. 그때까지 아무도 읽지 않는 그림자다.
